break_it.scenario: a wider watch list rebuilds more often and a rebuild kills a running cron job
break_it.what_happens: a long dcp-extract run is cut off by an unrelated merge
break_it.how: VERDICT (Sol finding, 2026-11-03): accepted. A killed run delays, it does not corrupt: each chapter is enqueued in one transaction and keeps needs_extraction=TRUE until it finishes, so the next run retries it. Measured: the run cut off by the 2026-11-02 20:31 deploy left 0 partial queue rows. The alternative (fixes that never deploy) left dcp-commit crashing daily. Merge outside 03:00-04:30 UTC.
break_it.repro: merge a change to any watched script while dcp-extract is running

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes - confirm dcp-commit rebuilds from this merge and its next run exits 0
